bundle.shortDescription: 本地优先 · 高性能 Markdown 知识库 / Local-first high-performance Markdown workspace
bundle.longDescription: Markelle 是本地优先、高性能的 Markdown 知识库工作台：打开本机文件夹即知识库，支持阅读编辑、双链图谱、日记附件、历史版本与本地 AI 助手。数据不出本机，无云同步。 / Markelle is a local-first, high-performance Markdown knowledge workspace: open a folder as a vault for editing, graphing, capture, history, and local AI. No cloud sync.
